rows.title: Cessation
rows.summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Deloitte Haskins and Sells, LLP as one of the Joint Statutory Auditors of the company w.e.f. October 16, 2026.

crossExchangeObservations.headline: Company has received communication from one of the joint statutory auditors - M/s. Deloitte Haskins on 16th October, 2026, regarding their cessation. Details are attached herewith.
crossExchangeObservations.subject: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Cessation
